svg.aria-label: A large globe in the middle with a burger, a cola cup, a film clapper, music notes, a hoodie and a phone orbiting it. On the left a lecturer speaks from a lectern and a student writes Cornell notes; on the right four puzzle pieces from 2012, 2016, 2023 and “me” fit together under the word synthesis. Lanterns hang above and a wave of blended colour flows below.
svg.title: Day 2: hear the voices, weave the sources — globalisation and culture
